name: scan-xml-security
description: Scans XML files including application configs, manifests, SAML metadata, SOAP definitions, and parser settings for XXE, insecure parser flags, plaintext credentials, weak transport, and disabled security constraints.
instructions:
# scan-xml-security

Scan XML documents and configuration files for XML-specific and configuration security risks.

## Orchestration

1. Load `references/rules.yaml` to get the active `XML-` rule set.
2. Include `*.xml`, `*.xsd`, `*.wsdl`, and XML-like config files from user-supplied paths or changed files.
3. Preserve element and attribute context when possible, such as `web-app/security-constraint`.
4. Evaluate each rule using its `match_strategy`, capturing file, line, snippet, and confidence.
5. Mark each rule `Pass`, `Fail`, `Partial`, `Unknown`, or `Not Applicable`.
6. Render the final report using `references/report-template.md`.

## Usage

Scan XML files in the current change:

```text
/scan-xml-security
```

Scan a specific XML config:

```text
/scan-xml-security config/web.xml metadata/
```

## Review Guidance

Prioritize parser behavior, external entities, inline credentials, disabled transport security, and authentication constraints.

rules.name: External Entity Declaration
rules.description: XML document declares an external entity that can enable XXE.
rules.remediation: Disable external entity resolution and remove external entity declarations.

rules.name: Plaintext Secret Element
rules.description: XML contains secret-looking elements or attributes with inline values.
rules.remediation: Store secrets in a secret manager and reference them outside the XML document.

rules.name: Secure Transport Disabled
rules.description: XML security constraints do not require confidential transport.
rules.remediation: Require confidential transport and TLS for protected resources.

rules.name: Security Constraint Disabled
rules.description: XML configuration disables or weakens authentication constraints.
rules.remediation: Enforce authentication methods for protected routes and services.

rules.name: Debug Mode Enabled
rules.remediation: Disable debug mode in shared or production configuration.
